subject: gk
question: Which committee is related to fundamental duties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Verma Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Verma Committee** is related to fundamental duties in India.
 
• The committee was established to operationalize the fundamental duties of citizens as enshrined in the Constitution of India.
 
• The fundamental duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976, under Article 51A.
 
• The Verma Committee provided recommendations to make fundamental duties more effective and enforceable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental duties** are moral obligations of all citizens to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India.
 
• They were added on the recommendation of the **Swaran Singh Committee** which was constituted by the government in 1976.
 
• The list of fundamental duties, initially ten, was increased to eleven by the 86th Amendment Act, 2002.
 
• These duties are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by law, but they serve as a constant reminder to citizens of their responsibilities.
